verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents an online exercise flow. The employee opens My Equity, clicks Exercise Now on an eligible grant, selects the number of shares, and e-signs the exercise documents, including spousal consent, with no paper forms. Share issuance is only implied: exercise actions are said to link to stock certificates. Missing for 10: any documented payment of the exercise price within the platform, explicit documentation of share or certificate issuance on completion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms

citations.quote: click on My Equity to view your available grants. Grants with an Exercise Now button have options available for exercise.
Select the number of shares you want to exercise. Sign the Exercise Documents and secure spousal consent (if applicable).
You can use your mouse to draw your signature, upload an image file of your signature, or type in your signature.
the award agreement will be tied to the corresponding board consent, subsequent exercise actions, stock certificates, and other future related documentation
